heartbeatCases.name: bounded heartbeat
heartbeatCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  heartbeat:
    every: 30m
    activeHours: { start: '09:00', end: '24:00', timezone: UTC }
    timeoutSeconds: 30

heartbeatCases.name: retired skipWhenBusy
heartbeatCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  heartbeat:
    every: 30m
    skipWhenBusy: true

agentCases.name: bounded coding
agentCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: [read]

agentCases.name: bounded static group
agentCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: ['group:fs']

agentCases.name: dynamic MCP bundle
agentCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: full
    allow: [bundle-mcp]

agentCases.name: overlong concrete MCP tool
agentCases.yaml:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  tools:
    profile: coding
    allow: [server_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789__tool_abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789]
